statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias
The service supports the diagnosis of atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The service supports the diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The denial reason was that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
